title: Prove sharp carryless channel widths for an ordinary product bit
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For separate encodings of two m-bit operands, recover bit m−1 of the ordinary integer product from binary polynomial products. The package proves the exact full-domain GF(2) matrix rank, floor(2^(m−1)/3) + floor(3m/2) − 1 for m ≥ 2. With odd operands, the exact input width per side falls from 2^(m−3)+1 for affine decoding to m−1 for nonlinear decoding. Asking for the next lower bit as well raises the minimum to m. A single jointly mixed width-(m+1) channel produces the full odd product modulo 2^m with an exponential lookup.

The explicit five-bit circuit attains width four with 18 AND and 35 XOR gates in total. Three decoder ANDs are necessary for its fixed encoding. The paper also gives matching all-position bounds for separated convolution digits. These quantities concern an interface to integer multiplication. The independently verified full-multiplier comparator from #7830 is 0.00387992803556; the target of 0.003884928046155 remains open. Claimed κ gain for this package is zero.

## Task and overlap

Base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Changed scope from the supplier-boundary-audit card to a separately encoded carryless front end. #6252 bounds the size of propagated carries, #6552 supplies finite-field slices, and #7834 computes a different Gaussian multiplication pipeline. This package derives a product-bit matrix rank and matching channel widths. The #7830 comparator is pinned at 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15.

## Validation and review requested

Run `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/carryless-middle-bit-rank` from the repository root with Python 3.12 on Linux. The checker covers the literal full and odd rank tables through m=12, 2,867,152 pre-carry digit comparisons, exhaustive five-bit gates, and 349,520 odd-input pairs for each of two field constructions through m=10. A separately written checker excluded every two-AND decoder for the five-bit encoding. Please review the valuation-zero elimination and the distinction between per-side width and actual gate cost.

## Credit and next question

Thathachar's 1997 work on ordered representations and Bryant's earlier work are antecedents for exponential rank arguments about middle-bit multiplication. Clear1nsight used OpenAI Codex for derivation, implementation, and independent agent review. Source pins, proof assumptions and reproducible controls are in the package.

For six-bit odd operands, can one width-six carryless product recover bits four and five together with a small table-free decoder? The exact width lower bound is six. The seven-coordinate field construction gives a control. A proposed width-six code can first be checked for conflicting returns on all 1,024 input pairs.
